title: Sunday Quick Tip
subtitle: Talk less
hook: How much of your last practice was you talking?
intro: You explain, correct, and explain again.
Kids spend more time listening than playing.
statement: Kids learn more from doing than from listening.
q1: Do you set a limit on how long you talk —
q2: or explain fully so nothing is missed?
q3: What could you say in half the time?
t1: Every coach is different. But kids improve faster
t2: when they spend more time playing.
cta: Coaches — how much do you talk?
ctaLines: Thirty seconds max. One point per drill. As needed.
ctaPrompt: Share your coaching habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
How much of your last practice was you talking?
You explain, correct, and explain again. Kids spend more time listening than playing.
Kids learn more from doing than from listening.
Less talk or full explanations. There is no perfect answer.
How much do you talk? Share your habit in the comments.
